body.name: Guard--vertex--edge weighted-support reduction
body.construction: For a nontrivial \(\textsc{Clique}\) instance \((G,s)\), use \(v\) missing vertex units, \(h=2v-s\) observed outcome-one anchors, and four observed outcome-zero controls. The realized row treats all vertex and anchor units and has unnormalized weight \(1\). For each vertex \(i\), a guard row exchanges vertex \(i\) for one control and has weight \(A_\star\); a vertex row exchanges vertex \(i\) and one anchor for two controls and has weight \(B\); for each edge \(ij\in E\), an edge row exchanges vertices \(i,j\) and two anchors for four controls and has weight \(1\). Normalize by \(W_\star\) and use threshold \(q_\star\).
